primary_endpoint: Proportion achieving NASH resolution without worsening of fibrosis based on histology from baseline to week 54 (after 52 weeks of treatment).
efficacy_outcome: NASH resolution occurred in 4 participants receiving AZD2693 25 mg, 1 receiving 50 mg, and 5 receiving placebo; reported p-values were 0.783 and 0.116.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 7/73 with AZD2693 25 mg, 3/69 with AZD2693 50 mg, and 7/74 with placebo; no deaths.
